THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CELL
CIRCULAR
No. ITC/808/2024
Date: 16/07/2024
Awareness cum Interaction session for the Advocate Clerks
on the Draft Vision Document
End to end paperless mode of working of the Court & the Registry
Under the guidance of Hon'ble the Chief Justice, High Court of
Gujarat, a vision document is being prepared for a full fledged software
suite and portal, viz. "eGujHC", for seamless end to end eMode of
working for the High Court of Gujarat as paperless Courts as well as
paperless Registry.
As Hon'ble the Chief Justice has been pleased to direct to have
interaction session with all the stakeholders, a presentation session with
the Advocate Clerks is scheduled to be held at 5:15 PM on 19/07/2024,
at Seminar Hall No.02, Gujarat High Court Auditorium, to brief about
the salient aspects and features of the draft vision document and to
invite inputs/suggestions for further enhancements in the draft vision
document.
